description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git revision parsing and related functionalities. It defines test cases for various Git commands involving commit references, parent revisions, and revision parsing edge cases.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev_output
methods.description: Compares the output of a Git revision command with an expected value using a specified comparison function.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing between commits.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of numbers, used to generate branch names or commit markers.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, and reports an error if it succeeds.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two values for equality within tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script upon successful completion.
